_note: Hand-verified club links for entries the UPSL scrape cannot reach (other leagues, or a club fielding sides in several). Same rule as the scrape: every row records the page the handle was read from. Applied by scripts/apply_manual_socials.py, additive by default -- a field is only allowed to overwrite an existing value when it is named in that club's "replace" list, so replacing curated data is always deliberate and reviewable.

arkansas-wolves-nisa.why: Arkansas Wolves FC's flagship entry had a website but no socials; arkansaswolves.com is the umbrella club (Youth, NPSL, UWS, UPSL Men, MWPL, NISA) and carries the club's real handles.

arkansa-wolves.why: Same club's League for Clubs entry — had neither website nor socials.

arkansas-wolves-2.why: UPSL side of Arkansas Wolves FC. Its url pointed at arkansaswolvesfc.sportzstudio.com, a separate 'Arkansas Wolves SC' microsite carrying @livestrongwolves rather than the club's @arkwolvesfc. Confirmed stale by Jeremy 2026-08-21; repointed at the club's own site.
